UDrawingObjects.pas::TDrawError.Create.text: Creates a new TDrawError at the origin with error number 0. The design rules check sets the position and number after creating it.

params.AOpts: the sheet options of the sheet the marker is on

UDrawingObjects.pas::TDrawError.GetType.text: Identifies this class's kind of object. The netlist ignores it and the file writer skips it.

UDrawingObjects.pas::TDrawError.SaveXML.text: Does nothing: a check marker is not part of the design and is never written to a file.

UDrawingObjects.pas::TDrawError.LoadXML.text: Does nothing: a check marker is never read from a file.

UDrawingObjects.pas::TDrawError.IsInside.text: Selection test, copied from CDrawError::IsInside: the marker is a square of half-size 6 (ERRORSIZE) around its point and counts as inside when that square touches the rectangle.
UDrawingObjects.pas::TDrawError.IsInside.returns: True if the marker is selected by that rectangle

UDrawingObjects.pas::TDrawError.Clone.text: Makes a copy of this marker (same point and error number).
UDrawingObjects.pas::TDrawError.Clone.returns: the new object; the caller owns it

UErc.pas::TStrMap.Search.returns: True if the key is in the map

params.Index: where the key is, or would be inserted

UErc.pas::TStrMap.Find.returns: True if the key is in the map

UErc.pas::TStrMap.Has.returns: True if the key is in the map

UErc.pas::TStrMap.SetValue.text: map[key] = value: adds the key or replaces its value.

UErc.pas::TStrMap.KeyAt.text: The key at a position in key order.

UErc.pas::TStrMap.ValueAt.text: The value at a position in key order.

UErc.pas::ErcOptionsFromWord.text: Unpacks the ErrorTest bit field: bit 0 is DupRef, then UnConnect, NoConnect, Power, OutputPwr, Output, NoOutput, UnConnected, MultipleNetNames, NonCaseDistinctNetNames, UnAssignedRefDes.

UErc.pas::ErcOptionsToWord.text: Packs the checks into the ErrorTest bit field (the unused bits 11 to 15 are zero).

UErc.pas::ErcDefaultWord.text: The registry default of the "ERC" value: every check on.

UErc.pas::ErcMessage.text: The strings of TinyCad.rc for the check's messages.
UErc.pas::ErcMessage.returns: the text, empty for a number that is not a message

UErc.pas::ErcTableLookup.text: One step of the state machine.
UErc.pas::ErcTableLookup.returns: the new net type, or an error id of ERR_BASE + 1 or more

params.NodeType: the type of the next node (0..6)

UErc.pas::SixDigits.text: Rounds the exact decimal value of X to six significant digits the way the C library does (exact ties go to the even digit). The exact value is built with whole-number arithmetic: the mantissa times 2^e is the mantissa times 5^-e shifted by -e places when e is negative.

params.X: a finite number greater than zero
params.E10: the decimal exponent of the first digit

UErc.pas::FormatG.text: Six significant digits, trailing zeros and a bare point removed, and the exponent form (1e+06, 1e-05) when the decimal exponent is below -4 or at least 6. The digits are exact (see SixDigits), so the result is the C library's for every number.
UErc.pas::FormatG.returns: the number as printf("%g") writes it

UErc.pas::ClearErcMarkers.text: Deletes every TDrawError object from every sheet (CTinyCadDoc::DeleteErrors).

UErc.pas::CountErcMarkers.returns: the number of markers on all sheets

UErc.pas::RunErc.text: DoSpecialCheck / DoSpecialVHDLCheck without the window: the same scans in the same order. Marker k belongs to line k of the messages. Markers of an earlier check are removed first.

params.Design: the design to check; markers are added to its sheets
params.Vhdl: True for the VHDL check (bus nets joined, output to output allowed)
params.AlwaysShowList: True to add the "No errors" line when nothing was found
params.Messages: receives the result lines (not cleared first)

erctest.pas::DoCheck.text: Test mode: runs the check on a design and prints the count, the markers and the lines.

Fercopts.pas::TfrmErcOptions.SetOptions.text: CDlgERCBox::OnInitDialog: copies the choices into the check boxes.

params.O: the checks to show as on

Fercopts.pas::TfrmErcOptions.LoadFromSet.text: Fills the dialog with the choices kept in the settings (the registry WORD, all on by default).

Fercwin.pas::TfrmErcList.Fill.text: Empties the list and adds the lines, each without the line end some of them carry.

params.Lines: the lines of the check's result

Fercwin.pas::TfrmErcList.SetSelect.text: Selects a line without it counting as the user's choice (so the sheet is not scrolled to it).

Fercwin.pas::TfrmErcList.ChooseItem.text: What clicking a line does: selects it and raises the choice event (CDlgERCListBox::OnClick). Used by the list's own event and by tests.

Fercwin.pas::TfrmErcList.ErrorsSelection.text: LBN_SELCHANGE: the user chose a line.

params.User: True when the user made the change

Fercwin.pas::TfrmErcList.FormClose.text: The window's own close button does what Close does (the window is hidden by the main form).

params.Sender: the component that raised the event
params.CloseAction: what to do with the window

UPainter.pas::TSchematicPainter.PaintErr.text: Draws the marker as CDrawError::Paint does: an empty circle of radius 6 with a 5 unit pen, dark red (127,0,0), or in the bus color when it is the selected marker.

mainform.pas::TfrmMain.DoNetList.text: Handler (Special > Create PCB Net List): drops any drawing tool, checks the design rules (the Design Markers window opens when there are errors), shows the PCB Export dialog and, on Export, writes the netlist of the current design. The choices are remembered when Export is pressed, whether or not the file could be written.

params.Sender: the component that raised the event

mainform.pas::TfrmMain.BeginErcDialog.text: The start of Special > Check Design Rules (CTinyCadView::OnSpecialCheck): any drawing tool is put away and the dialog gets the checks that are on (the registry WORD "ERC").
mainform.pas::TfrmMain.BeginErcDialog.returns: the dialog, filled with the choices kept; the caller shows it and frees it

mainform.pas::TfrmMain.FinishErcDialog.text: What Check does: the choices are kept, then the check runs and its list is shown.

params.F: the dialog, after Check was pressed

mainform.pas::TfrmMain.RunCheck.text: DoSpecialCheck / DoSpecialVHDLCheck of the current design: the markers of an earlier check are taken away, the check puts its markers on the sheets and the Design Markers window shows the lines when there are errors or AlwaysShow (then with the line "No errors were found"). When nothing is to be shown an open window for this design is closed (TinyCAD would leave the earlier list there). The checks that are on are the ones kept in the settings.

params.AlwaysShow: True to show the list even when nothing was found

mainform.pas::TfrmMain.ShowErcList.text: Opens the Design Markers window (or reuses it) with the lines (CDlgERCListBox::Open).

params.ADoc: the document the markers are in

mainform.pas::TfrmMain.CloseErcWindow.text: Closes the Design Markers window (CDlgERCListBox::Close): the markers are taken off the document's sheets. Not cleared when the document is being closed.

params.DoClear: True to take the markers off the sheets

mainform.pas::TfrmMain.ErcCloseRequest.text: The Close button or the window's close button.

mainform.pas::TfrmMain.ErcRecheck.text: The Re-check button: the markers are taken off and the plain check is run again, whichever check made the list (as TinyCAD does).

mainform.pas::TfrmMain.ErcPcbNetlist.text: The Generate PCB Netlist button: Special > Create PCB Net List for the design.

mainform.pas::TfrmMain.ErcSpiceNetlist.text: The Generate SPICE Netlist button: Special > Create Spice Net List for the design.

mainform.pas::TfrmMain.ErcItemChosen.text: CDlgERCListBox::OnClick: shows the marker with that number: the document and the sheet it is on, the sheet scrolled to put the marker in the middle (the zoom is the user's), the marker selected and brought to the front of the sheet's objects.

mainform.pas::TfrmMain.BeginNetList.text: The start of Special > Create PCB Net List (CTinyCadView::OnSpecialNet): any drawing tool is put away, the design rules are checked (the list shows only when there are errors), then the dialog is made.
mainform.pas::TfrmMain.BeginNetList.returns: the PCB Export dialog, filled as it starts; the caller shows it and frees it

mainform.pas::TfrmMain.BeginSpice.text: The start of Special > Create Spice Net List: any drawing tool is put away and the design rules are checked, then the name to propose is worked out.
mainform.pas::TfrmMain.BeginSpice.returns: the file name the Save dialog proposes

mainform.pas::TfrmMain.BeginVhdl.text: The start of Special > Create VHDL file: any drawing tool is put away and the VHDL design rules are checked, then the name to propose is worked out.
mainform.pas::TfrmMain.BeginVhdl.returns: the file name the Save dialog proposes

mainform.pas::TfrmMain.ErcChoose.text: For tests: chooses a line of the Design Markers window as a click does.

mainform.pas::TfrmMain.ErcPress.text: For tests: presses a button of the Design Markers window (a dimmed button does nothing).

mainform.pas::TfrmMain.ErcWindowText.text: For tests: the Design Markers window: open, the document it belongs to, the number of lines, the line selected, whether the symbol reference button is enabled, and the lines (separated by |).

nettest.pas::Num.returns: the number with all its digits, for a program that reads it back

nettest.pas::DoErcNodes.text: Test mode: prints the nodes with the details the design rules check reads, and the placed symbols.
